_comment: Map friendly names to MadMapper OSC addresses. In MadMapper, right-click a parameter and choose Copy OSC Address, then paste it here. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

surfaces._comment: Friendly name -> surface name as shown in MadMapper (becomes /surfaces/<Name>/opacity), or a full opacity address starting with /.

triggers._comment: Friendly name -> full OSC address of a button, cue or scene control. Paste the address from Copy OSC Address.

parameters._comment: Shader parameter name -> OSC address. Load materials/HandStringVisualizer.fs in MadMapper, right-click each slider, choose Copy OSC Address and paste it here. These example addresses are guesses.

_parameter_scale_comment: raw sends values in the shader's own range (sensitivity 0-4). If MadMapper's sliders jump to the max, set this to normalized to send 0-1 instead.
